metadata.description: Local Standalone HeavyGRU vs SupervisedDenseMLP Baselines
metadata.statistical_limitations: Statistical comparisons are based on N=10 paired client observations. With N=10, the paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test has limited statistical power (minimum two-sided p-value 0.00195). Failure to reject the null hypothesis (p >= 0.05) must NOT be interpreted as evidence of equivalence. Furthermore, W=1 GRU input vectors do not model physical temporal sequence dynamics; the comparison strictly evaluates the non-linear feature extraction and gating capacity of the two architectures.
